# A force to change motion, not to keep it

<!-- STEP id="change" -->
Suppose there is no friction. Then a force is needed to set an object moving, to change its velocity, or to stop it. No force is needed to keep it moving at a constant velocity.

<!-- STEP id="real" -->
On real floors, friction always acts. So a moving box slows down unless we keep pushing it. Our push only balances the friction.
